practice.title: Study one question at a time
practice.intro: Choose a slice of the Java bank. A single answer moves you straight to the next question. Multiple-answer questions wait until you continue. Explanations stay hidden until you review them later.

exam.runningBody: Your answers and the deadline are saved in this browser. Resume, or discard it and start over.
exam.title: Java QCM simulation
exam.intro: A full simulation is 80 questions in 60 minutes, with 85% required to pass. Some questions have more than one correct answer: select each of them. This mock hides explanations until you submit.
exam.invalid: Enter a question count from 1 to 200 and a time limit from 1 to 180 minutes.
exam.keys: A single answer opens the next question. On multiple-answer questions, select every option, then continue. Explanations stay hidden until you submit. Keys: 1–9 answer, Enter moves ahead, F bookmarks.
exam.missingMessage: The saved exam points at a question that is no longer in the bank.
